therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: HDL cholesterol elevation and LDL cholesterol reduction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with coronary heart disease and/or diabetes mellitus at high cardiovascular risk
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Time to first occurrence of a major cardiovascular disease event

safety_signals: Trial was terminated early; torcetrapib was associated with increased mortality and cardiovascular events in the ILLUMINATE trial, leading to program-wide termination

context.investigator_commentary: Trial terminated early. The torcetrapib development program was halted due to increased mortality and cardiovascular events observed in the concurrent ILLUMINATE outcomes trial, indicating an off-target adverse effect of torcetrapib independent of CETP inhibition.

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Torcetrapib was hypothesized to amplify atorvastatin's cardiovascular risk reduction by raising HDL-C in addition to atorvastatin's LDL-C lowering, but the trial was terminated due to torcetrapib's off-target harm, precluding demonstration of additive benefit.
